nodes.label: SYSTEM: how GLUE works now
nodes.rationale: The single source of truth for how GLUE works today: the Website, GLUE folder (JSON store, profiles, collections), GLUE Home (Tauri app, Rust engine, local link, streams, analysis in Rust), GLUE Cloud (Cloudflare Worker, accounts, devices). A change that alters how GLUE works updates this file in the same commit.

nodes.label: glue-audio: native analysis engine
nodes.rationale: Rust line-for-line port of the TypeScript analysis with JavaScript's numbers. GLUE Home links it since 0.44, makes every stored file in 0.45, analyses with it in 0.46, has no audio JavaScript left since 0.47. DSD analysed as 88.2 kHz PCM with a finding. Tested: tests/golden (GOLDEN=1 regenerates TypeScript, then ports), crates/glue-audio/tests/golden.rs compares. CLI: glue-audio analyse | bench. Lossy goldens from Edge (e2e/golden.spec.ts, GOLDEN=1).

nodes.label: glue-store: library store in Rust
nodes.rationale: CollectionStore, shared projections and repair. Ported line for line with JavaScript's JSON rules, held byte for byte to TypeScript by tests/golden/store (golden.test.ts writes, golden.rs replays). ADR 0152. The engine's since 0.52. Its backups read by the website's readBackup.

nodes.label: glue-engine: GLUE Home's library engine
nodes.rationale: ADR 0153, 0154: crates/glue-engine. One store per collection (glue-store), written straight to disk. Applies tab edits, feeds changes back, repairs and moves to-be-sorted. Its jobs (remove songs) carry on after restart. Without a GLUE folder chosen it runs over its own: online, taking sent songs, refusing tab requests. One pipeline: songs asked for now, new songs' tags, library songs, then background thumbnails for other devices (ADR 0157). Passing failures (timeouts, memory) retried, never stored; after third try saved as failed (ADR 0109, 0144).

nodes.label: Verdict: quality verdict system
nodes.rationale: src/core/audio/verdict.ts: determines if file is genuine hi-res, lossless, transcoded, upsampled, etc. A rule change bumps VERDICT_VERSION, stored verdicts re-judged from details kept, never file: in browser on open (recheckVerdicts), once a run in GLUE Home (verdicts.rs, glue_audio::recheck, ADR 0166). Details live in caches, not GLUE folder. Parity checked against legacy/index.html (tests/parity.test.ts).

nodes.label: Shared collection: account's collection form
nodes.rationale: With cloud sync on, every collection is the account's. Shared form: collection.json has shared, members (computer → folder and name), rootsBy (each computer's music folders). Song has copies[computer] (file on each). Same file on two computers (size, name or 'Name (2)') is one song with copy on each (ADR 0130). Analyses per computer. here(meta, me) projects it. Only GLUE folder for a computer writes that computer's parts (ADR 0108). Store opened as own writes nothing once shared (reads before save, OutdatedStore).

nodes.label: Analysis queue: one pipeline in GLUE Home
nodes.rationale: ADR 0154, 0157: crates/glue-engine/src/queue.rs. One pipeline inside 'songs at a time': songs asked for now (tab 'Analyse now', other device waiting), new songs' tags, library songs, background thumbnails. Each job counted in window meter and list. Edit queues its songs (added, file changed). Collections looked through at start, after sync takes changes in, on Restart. Failures retried, never stored (ADR 0109). Song has 2 minutes or 1 second/MB.

nodes.label: GLUE Home: Tauri tray app
nodes.rationale: ADR 0044: Tauri 2 app with tray icon. engine.rs hosts the Rust engine. Settings window and drag dock (no hidden page). First run guide (ADR 0159). Window opens on library, signed in by single-use code. Settings: code, computer name, incoming folder, start with computer, received songs. Tray right-click: status, Open library, settings, Start/Stop/Restart, Quit.

nodes.label: Local link: connection from browser to GLUE Home
nodes.rationale: ADR 0048: http://127.0.0.1:47400-47409. /hello (who it is), /connect (hands token to browser's origin for any browser on computer), /fs/* (disk), /cache (analyses), /rpc (engine), /lease, /attach, /incoming, /dock, /folders. Every route but /hello and /connect needs token. Stopped (Stop in tray), answers only GLUE Home's windows. Paces analysis reads when song plays (ADR 0140). Songs played get own port (ADR 0141). File read resolves only its folder.

nodes.label: Stream channel: WebRTC to other devices
nodes.rationale: ADR 0047, 0076: requests at same time, tagged bytes, time limits. GLUE Home's side in Rust since 0.49 (glue-rtc, ADR 0150). To other computers over WebRTC (direct or TURN, ADR 0081). range {start, len} requests on stream channel answer part of song at most 8 MB at a time (ADR 0076).

nodes.label: Repairs: open-time and sync collection fixes
nodes.rationale: ADR 0166: tidying (songs naming gone import lose it, only-import record goes away), matching (songs with no file fold into song that has it), joining (this computer's song that's same file as another's joins it). GLUE Home does these in Rust (repairs.rs) when opening collection and after sync, not the page (ADR 0162). More than 10 songs to join get backup first. Store goldens tidy and join hold it to website byte for byte.
